projects.title: Ninjacart
projects.subtitle: Pricing intelligence for dark-store growth
projects.description: Buying decisions across a fast-growing dark-store network had no reliable view of competitor prices. I built a 12-week price intelligence model across 300 SKUs and automated daily competitor tracking with WhatsApp reporting, cutting purchase price by INR 4 a unit and supporting expansion in Hyderabad from 5 to 30 stores.

media.caption: Daily competitor price tracker, built on Google Apps Script and Twilio

projects.title: Lawxy AI
projects.subtitle: Fundraise and go-to-market
projects.description: A pre-seed legal-AI startup needed to raise and find its first customers at the same time. I built the investor materials and ran diligence follow-ups with Peak XV, and ran structured outbound to enterprises, taking the round to term-sheet stage and onboarding 15 pilot clients.

media.caption: Investor materials built for the pre-seed round
Structured outbound that led to 8 enterprise meetings in a week

projects.title: Newton School
projects.subtitle: Building a placement pilot from zero
projects.description: A new alumni placement vertical had no process, tracking or candidate pipeline. I wrote the operating SOP, built the funnel tracker across 15+ companies, and onboarded candidates through one-on-one calls, reaching 55% assessment completion and the pilot's first placement.

projects.title: Track Monitoring
projects.subtitle: Railway defect detection, Smart India Hackathon 2025
projects.description: Indian Railways relies on costly imported track-monitoring systems, and no public dataset of Indian track defects existed. I owned the computer-vision defect detection pipeline, built the dataset by capturing and augmenting on-track images, and debugged live inference on an ESP32 camera, placing top 3 of 80 teams and field-testing on live Central Railway track in Mumbai.

media.caption: The prototype mounted on live Central Railway track in Mumbai
Fastener detection with bounding boxes and a live sensor readout

projects.title: WorldQuant BRAIN
projects.subtitle: Alpha research, Gold level
projects.description: WorldQuant's open research platform scores contributors on trading signals that have to survive out-of-sample validation, not just look good on paper. Sustained submissions over two to three months took me past 10,000 points to Gold level, with a Research Consultant offer following the record.

projects.title: Agent Teardowns
projects.subtitle: Arrowhead and Juicebox
projects.description: AI agents look good in demos. Where do they actually fail? I mapped a voice bot's collections call turn by turn against a funnel, and traced how a recruiting agent turned my feedback into search filters, finding the voice bot's real leak was comprehension, not interest, and catching the recruiting agent testing a 9-month filter but shipping 6.

media.caption: Call-by-call map of the collections voice bot against its funnel
The recruiting agent's filters, traced back to my own feedback
